agreements: V2 preserves the project thesis: THINK owns live child thought/action/outcome, DREAM only reconstructs bounded context, personal SLEEP is an ordinary response-only write over provenance-supported child experience, and bootstrap schooling is a separate immutable birth initialization rather than a fourth cognitive organ.

The merge-once BF16 birth topology, fresh zero-effective-delta personal adapters, typed evidence-to-lesson-to-view-to-exposure identities, and one atomic committed lineage head are coherent architecture choices; no current organism_v6 path implements or certifies them.
The direct-solution arm is an active curriculum control, not a semantic neutral, and M0 is a no-bootstrap damage and pre-existing-competence diagnostic.
Immediate standardized-advice receptivity, fixed-policy development, and adaptive parent-child-SLEEP development are separate estimands and must retain their narrow labels.

Personal SLEEP may use only supported child-native traces and public lived outcomes; static bootstrap conditioning may be attended and response-loss-masked, but live longitudinal parent text may not enter personal SLEEP prompts or labels.

Disposable advice clones, developmental exams, standardized panels, and final evaluation must be causally terminal and may not update the continuing child, parent, ledger, compiler, selection process, or later roots.

Repetition is demonstrated by selective uncued action and public outcome across relevant cases, reset, fade, relapse, and restoration; phrase echo is not uptake, and repetition has no causal-benefit claim without its own randomization.

Exact supervised response-token counts and positions, mask geometry, action positions, batch/update opportunity, seeds, and configuration can be matched across bootstrap arms; token identities in declared treatment spans, gradients, Adam moments, and realized optimizer paths cannot and need not match.

Two-root V2_ES09-V2_ES11 results are sequential feasibility screens only; scientific claims require separately frozen at-least-six-new-root replication, uncertainty and multiplicity rules, construct and safety gates, fresh review, and explicit human claim authority.
Natural K4-versus-K1 identifies only the total cadence package; standardized-ledger and within-ledger terminal comparisons are conditional descriptions rather than a mediation decomposition.
The proposal currently supplies no implementation, tokenizer/model execution, corpus, benchmark, adapter, birth, GPU, publication, or scientific-claim authority.

disagreements.issue: Whether response-loss masking permits live longitudinal parent prose to remain an attended personal-SLEEP conditioning input despite the visibility matrix forbidding that prose to SLEEP_COMPILER.

positions.position: The PARENT_TO_CHILD_TO_SLEEP edge says parent prose is context-only and response-loss-masked, which permits an attended personal-writer prompt reading.

Live parent bytes may be attended only during waking and must then be excluded or irreversibly redacted from every personal SLEEP prompt and label; attended response masking applies only to static bootstrap conditioning.

resolution.rationale: A masked token still conditions gradients on loss-bearing response tokens, so the edge and matrix encode different causal graphs. The stronger owner-directed personal-SLEEP exclusion is selected, but it must appear in revised exact proposal bytes rather than be inferred during implementation.
resolution.selected_position: Exclude or irreversibly redact raw live longitudinal parent bytes from every personal SLEEP input and target, retaining only restricted auditor-side provenance; reserve attended response-loss-masked conditioning for the separate static bootstrap writer.
resolution.required_change: Revise the edge, visibility product, and affected tests; add V2_ES19_VISIBILITY_PRODUCT_NONINTERFERENCE or its exact successor before seeking architecture ratification.

disagreements.issue: Whether final.public_observation can be visible to SLEEP_COMPILER while advice clones, development exams, standardized panels, and final evaluations are specified as disposable and reporting-only.

positions.position: The broad final.public_observation item is visible to SLEEP_COMPILER and may therefore enter grounded traces.

Ordinary developmental public outcomes and evaluation public observations are different information types; only the former may become personal evidence, while every evaluation output is causally terminal.

resolution.rationale: One information item cannot safely denote both continuing lived evidence and sealed evaluation output. The current cell creates an evaluation-to-learning path that would invalidate all three bootstrap estimands and later transfer or cadence evidence.
resolution.selected_position: Split developmental.public_observation from evaluation.public_observation and forbid the latter from the continuing child, parent, ledger, compiler, cache/selection state, and later roots.
resolution.required_change: Revise the exact visibility matrix and affected assay/test bytes; add V2_ES19_VISIBILITY_PRODUCT_NONINTERFERENCE or its exact successor.

disagreements.issue: Whether a fixed policy that cannot inspect child behavior can share an acquisition-triggered reminder-fade-relapse-restoration loop.

positions.position: PARENT_REPETITION_AND_FADE applies to lessons assigned by fixed or adaptive policies and reads committed child history to change reminders.

Fixed-policy advice and repetition timing must be exogenous and byte-identical across births; acquisition and relapse are outcomes only, while behavior-triggered schedule changes belong solely to the adaptive package.

resolution.rationale: Behavior-triggered fade consumes treatment-dependent child behavior and makes advice timing differ across births, contradicting the fixed-policy estimand. This is a causal-policy contradiction, not a deferred numeric constant.
resolution.selected_position: Use one preregistered exogenous reminder/fade schedule for all fixed-policy lineages and reserve behavior-triggered fade/restoration for adaptive-package cells.
resolution.required_change: Revise the fixed-policy node, repetition loop scope, V2_ES10, and V2_ES12; add V2_ES10R_FIXED_POLICY_EXOGENOUS_SCHEDULE or its exact successor.

disagreements.issue: Whether V2_ES14 can measure unreplayed personal parametric retention when every replacement personal adapter is trained fresh from the immutable birth and the sentinel is absent from all later views.

positions.position: A personal sentinel excluded from later compiler views can be compared with a never-written sentinel and previous child to report unreplayed retention.

The omitted earlier personal delta has no weight path into a fresh-from-birth replacement; later behavior can only reflect correlated or descendant data, so the named parametric-retention construct is unavailable.
An exact later compiler exclusion is necessary, but the test must remain consistent with cumulative closure and inherited-birth semantics.

resolution.rationale: The scientific objection is decisive for the selected topology: removing the sentinel from later views removes both its data path and its earlier parameter path. An exclusion audit alone cannot turn descendant/generalized behavior into survival of an earlier weight update.
resolution.selected_position: Replace V2_ES14 with a topology-valid pre-replacement probe or an explicitly labeled cumulative-ledger survival/generalization assay with descendant/correlated support audited; any weight-continuous alternative requires separate architecture deliberation.
resolution.required_change: Replace and relabel V2_ES14 in revised proposal bytes as V2_ES14R_TOPOLOGY_VALID_PERSONAL_RETENTION or an exact successor, and forbid unreplayed prior-weight-retention language under the current topology.

disagreements.issue: Which pre-candidate wake evidence, child notes, parent messages/playbook state, and repetition state survive when the following personal SLEEP candidate is rejected.

positions.position: Only a committed closure is visible and rejected artifacts never influence future corpus, briefs, context, or selection, but legitimate pre-candidate wake and parent state are not assigned an independent-commit, rollback, or quarantine rule.
The successor proposal must choose exact weight-parent, data-parent, state-parent, quarantine, retry, and future-visibility semantics because this choice changes the next compiler and parent history.

resolution.rationale: The architecture is non-unique until this transition is selected. Filesystem CAS mechanics may be deferred, but whether valid wake/parent state survives a failed weight candidate changes the loop and causal ancestry itself.
resolution.selected_position: Require new exact proposal bytes to choose independent commit, rollback, or permanent quarantine for every affected state class and bind the next-head and retry semantics.
resolution.required_change: Revise SLEEP_COMPILE_WRITE_COMMIT and ATOMIC_LINEAGE_HEAD semantics and add V2_ES20_REJECTED_SLEEP_WAKE_STATE_ANCESTRY or its exact successor.

disagreements.issue: How to interpret exact response-token matching across T/D and identical SLEEP across fixed-policy birth arms without requiring impossible token, gradient, ledger, or adapter identity.

positions.position: Response token identities and realized personal writes match exactly across treatment arms.

Match exogenous supervised-token counts/positions, masks, action locations, schedule, writer/configuration, initialized opportunity, gates, and budgets; permit declared treatment token identities and treatment-induced grounded ledgers, gradients, adapters, and decisions to differ.

resolution.rationale: Different intended computations necessarily create different response tokens and optimizer trajectories, and different child behavior necessarily creates different personal evidence. The joint proposal text already permits named span differences and describes the same SLEEP mechanism, so this is a binding interpretation rather than an additional topology choice.
resolution.selected_position: Require equality of exogenous opportunity and mechanism, never equality of declared treatment content, realized gradients/Adam paths, or treatment-induced personal artifacts.
resolution.required_change: State this reading explicitly in revised V2_ES03/V2_ES10 bytes and later receipts so no impossible equality test or cross-arm experience copying is implemented.

disagreements.issue: Whether Delta_F isolates teaching or intrinsic teachability, target blindness is absolute, canary passes release claims, repetition establishes a causal benefit, or cadence terminal contrasts identify mediation.

positions.position: Use fixed-policy learning, task-blind, required-before-scientific-claim, repetition, and cadence language as sufficient for broad mechanism claims.

Delta_F is fixed-curriculum-plus-personal-SLEEP development relative to D; blindness excludes only incremental downstream-derived input; two-root canaries only license later spending; repetition is descriptive absent randomization; cadence terminal contrasts are conditional, not mediation.

resolution.rationale: The narrow joint reading is already supported by the proposal's claim/test dependencies and bound rework source. It must govern every later report and intake, but it does not add a new graph beyond the five proposal blockers.
resolution.selected_position: Retain the narrow package-relative, incremental, feasibility-only, descriptive, and total-package labels exactly; require separately frozen six-new-root confirmation and authority for claims.
resolution.required_change: Carry these limits explicitly into the reworked proposal and every later implementation, execution, review, and claim packet; any broader claim requires new deliberation.

disagreements.issue: Whether deferred checkpoint, writer, merge, resolver, receipt, and platform transaction details make the architecture topology itself non-ratifiable.

positions.position: The topology is unique, but multiple executable byte graphs remain because exact roots, encodings, tolerances, resolver rules, receipt schemas, and CAS mechanics are unbound.

These gaps block implementation or first relevant execution, but are legitimate future exact contract inputs because V2 already requires them to be frozen and tested; only a choice that changes graph, visibility, tests, or claims restarts architecture deliberation.

resolution.rationale: The systems diagnosis of current non-executability is accepted, while the implication that every implementation constant is a proposal-byte blocker is rejected. Architecture and exact implementation authority remain separate gates.
resolution.selected_position: Treat v2 as architecture only; after successor architecture approval, bind a separately scoped exact implementation contract before code or execution, restarting deliberation for any material architecture effect.
resolution.required_change: The later contract must bind exact M0/tokenizer/chat-template/toolchain roots, dependency versions, traversal/precision/RNG behavior, initializer tensors, checkpoint-root encoding, tensor ties/sharding, merge/parity tolerances, support resolver, receipts, and CAS/fsync/concurrency/recovery protocol.

disagreements.issue: Whether candidate microdomains, semantic control validity, primary statistics, safety rules, and the writer factorial are already executable or established facts.

positions.position: The named unrelated microdomains, six computations, margins, root counts, and writer assay descriptions are sufficiently fixed to construct data and interpret evidence.

Microdomains remain candidates pending structural audit, and exact generators/splits, semantic rubrics, difficulty thresholds, endpoints, allocation, safety estimands, inference, writer factors, prompts, margins, aggregation, invalid handling, and directional controls must be frozen before generation or execution.

resolution.rationale: These gaps prevent corpus generation, execution, and claims but do not change the selected higher-level contrast unless a later contract alters graph, visibility, tests, or claims. Post-hoc selection, renaming, control addition, or precision/statistic changes are forbidden.
resolution.selected_position: Keep these as separately reviewed future data, audit, execution, and evidence-contract gates; failed structural/control audits require new ratified bytes rather than outcome-informed repair.
resolution.required_change: Before generation or model execution, bind exact source/generator/split identities; semantic coder rubric and adjudication; M0 difficulty failure rule; Delta_R Y; ages/AUC; allocation and root-level intervals/multiplicity; solo resource controller; distinct safety estimands; and the dose-matched writer factorial with disjoint identities and per-control directional predictions.

disagreements.issue: Whether adjudication may repair or ratify the five normative proposal contradictions and release implementation or execution.

positions.position: Consensus can select intended meanings and allow the current proposal hash to proceed.

The five architecture contradictions require revised exact proposal bytes, a fresh complete deliberation, and explicit human ratification; later implementation, review, GPU, and claim gates remain separately closed.

resolution.rationale: Exact-byte authority cannot be inferred from model agreement, and consensus cannot mutate the proposal it adjudicates. Rework is therefore mandatory even though the preferred repair direction is identified.
resolution.selected_position: Recommend rework of the exact current proposal and prohibit all implementation or execution; only a successor proposal may enter a new deliberation and later human decision.
resolution.required_change: Produce new exact architecture-change bytes resolving V2R01-V2R05, then rerun two fresh interpretations, critique, adjudication, and human ratification before any separately scoped downstream work.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Loss masking does not remove causal conditioning, so the edge and forbidden visibility cell encode incompatible personal-SLEEP graphs. This is proposal-byte blocker one of five.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Revise exact proposal bytes to exclude/redact live parent bytes from all personal SLEEP prompts and labels and add a visibility-product noninterference test.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Developmental lived outcomes and disposable evaluation outcomes require different lineage visibility. This is proposal-byte blocker two of five.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Split the information items and make every advice/exam/panel/final-evaluation output reporting-only and causally terminal.

concern_dispositions.rationale: A policy cannot be behavior-blind while changing its reminder schedule from treatment-dependent acquisition or relapse. This is proposal-byte blocker three of five.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Use an identical exogenous fixed-policy schedule and reserve behavior-triggered fade/restoration for adaptive-package cells.

concern_dispositions.rationale: A fresh-from-birth replacement adapter has no parameter ancestry from an omitted prior sentinel. This is proposal-byte blocker four of five.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Replace or relabel V2_ES14 with a topology-valid assay; any weight-continuous alternative needs its own deliberation.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Independent commit, rollback, and permanent quarantine produce different future child/parent/compiler histories. This is proposal-byte blocker five of five.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Choose exact weight-, data-, and state-parent semantics plus quarantine, retry, and future visibility and add a state-ancestry fault test.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Literal token or optimizer-path equality is impossible for the intended treatment; exact exogenous opportunity equality is the coherent joint reading and is not a sixth topology blocker.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Clarify V2_ES03 so identities may differ only in declared treatment spans while counts, positions, masks, action locations, schedule, seeds, and configuration match.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Identical SLEEP means identical mechanism and exogenous opportunity, not equal treatment-induced corpora, gradients, adapters, or promotion decisions.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Preserve this explicit reading in V2_ES10 and later receipts; do not copy experiences across arms.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Delta_F includes the fixed curriculum and active personal-SLEEP mechanism and cannot isolate advice alone, intrinsic teachability, or a weight-only pathway.
The audit can exclude new downstream-derived input but cannot erase knowledge in M0/demonstrator or establish conceptual unrelatedness before structural review.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Use target-blind only as shorthand for incremental construction nondependence and report bounded structural-audit results.

concern_dispositions.rationale: The required joint reading of V2_ES09-V2_ES11 with V2_ES17-V2_ES18 makes two-root passes feasibility gates only.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Require separately frozen at-least-six-new-root replication, inference/multiplicity, fresh review, and human claim authority.

concern_dispositions.rationale: The current architecture does not identify executable bytes, but these enumerated details are later exact implementation-contract gates rather than proposal-byte blockers unless they materially change architecture.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Bind every listed root, encoding, tolerance, resolver, receipt, RNG, and transaction-platform detail before implementation or first relevant execution.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Unrelatedness and T/D manipulation purity are test results, not premises. Exact sources and audit rules are later data-contract gates, not a sixth proposal blocker.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Freeze generators/splits, structural and action-equivalence audits, six-computation rubric/coders/adjudication, and the quantitative M0 difficulty failure rule before corpus generation.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Margins and root counts alone do not define reproducible estimands, but the proposal already assigns these constants to a later pre-generation contract.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Freeze Y, ages/AUC, allocation/blocking, root inference/multiplicity, rerun/missingness/termination rules, solo resources, and distinct safety comparators before generation or execution.

concern_dispositions.rationale: The headline writer claim needs an exact factorial and directional controls; this blocks execution and claims but is a later evidence-contract gate under the present graph.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Bind factors, disjoint identities, prompts, scoring, margins, aggregation, invalid handling, and per-control disappearance/reversal/redirection before generation.

concern_dispositions.rationale: V2 adds no causal repetition claim and correctly narrows cadence to a total package plus conditional descriptions; these limits must remain explicit.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Do not claim repetition benefit without randomization or cadence mediation from terminal contrasts.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Five normative conflicts require revised bytes and a fresh full gate; neither critique nor consensus can amend or ratify the current proposal.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Permit only successor proposal-byte rework followed by fresh deliberation and exact human decisions; keep every implementation/execution/claim scope forbidden.

upstream_disagreement_dispositions.rationale: Accepted: the earlier personal delta has no path into a fresh-from-birth replacement, so V2_ES14 needs a topology-valid construct.
Accepted: fixed-policy reminder timing must remain exogenous and identical across births.
Accepted: raw live parent bytes must be excluded/redacted from personal SLEEP, not merely loss-masked.
Accepted: Delta_F is a fixed-curriculum-plus-personal-SLEEP interaction, not teaching alone or intrinsic receptivity.
Accepted: match response counts/positions and optimizer opportunity while allowing token identities only in declared treatment spans.
Accepted: construction nondependence cannot certify absence of pretrained knowledge or universal conceptual separation.
Accepted: two-root canaries license only sequential spending, never scientific claims.
Accepted that executable bytes remain non-unique and current code supplies no implementation; rejected only the implication that all deferred constants defeat the selected proposal-level topology.
Accepted: fixed-policy arms share the SLEEP mechanism and opportunity, not realized personal evidence or updates.
Accepted independently: masking live parent prompt tokens would still violate the stronger personal-SLEEP exclusion.
Accepted: evaluation observations require a distinct reporting-only type with no continuing-lineage edge.
Accepted: the candidate families earn disjointness only through the frozen structural audit.

acceptance_test_dispositions.rationale: Retain the exact-byte authority invariant. It presently requires rework and a fresh deliberation before any successor ratification; architecture approval would still not release later implementation or execution.
Keep the five typed identities and dual support validation, while adding live-parent exclusion, developmental-versus-evaluation typing, and the selected rejected-SLEEP state ancestry.

Replace literal response-token identity with exact supervised response counts/positions and exogenous opportunity equality; allow identities only in declared treatment spans and prove live parent bytes are absent from personal writer prompts and labels.
Retain the model-free A-nonzero/B-zero gradient fixture and all-zero negative fixture; exact tensors and RNG namespaces belong to the later implementation contract.
Retain reference arithmetic, content identity, inventory, parity, and symmetric rounding-loss requirements; freeze exact roots, encoding, toolchain, and tolerances before first relevant execution.

The fault matrix must also prove the newly selected ancestry semantics for valid wake evidence, child notes, parent/playbook state, and repetition state around a rejected personal candidate, plus evaluation noninterference.

Retain permanent pairing, replay, whole-sequence manipulation audit, M0 calibration, and D safety under the active-control label; exact rubrics, coders, strata, and gross-difficulty failure rule are later pre-generation/execution gates.
Retain incremental nondependence, temporal/ACL/mutation isolation, action-equivalence and structural audits; it cannot certify absence of pretrained knowledge or unrelatedness before the audit.

Keep disposable same-state correct/none/irrelevant/wrong clones and Delta_R, while explicitly proving every clone observation and transcript is reporting-only and absent from all continuing state and later roots.

Use an exogenous identical advice/repetition/fade schedule that never inspects child behavior, equal mechanism/opportunity rather than realized write identity, causally terminal exams, and the fixed-curriculum-plus-personal-SLEEP label.

Retain the ecological package interaction, but explicitly type every exam/panel output as terminal, include the selected rejected-write state rule, and preserve parent information/effort as treatment rather than a controlled-away mediator.

Split exogenous fixed-policy reminder schedules from behavior-triggered adaptive fade/restoration, prove raw parent bytes never reach personal SLEEP, and retain only behavioral uptake claims absent a repetition randomization.

Retain separate source reproduction, held-out extraction, fresh use, semantic controls, and preservation, while adding exact factorial/split/directional-control contract requirements and evaluation/live-parent noninterference.

The named prior-weight retention path does not exist under fresh-from-birth replacement writing. Replace it with a pre-replacement probe or explicitly labeled cumulative-ledger survival/generalization with descendant and correlated support audited.
Retain the equal-exposure engineering grid and its strict capacity-by-exposure label; it supports no generic plasticity, update-strength, or age claim.
Retain total-package and conditional-ledger labels, while proving disposable terminal evaluation cannot enter later ledgers or continuing state under the repaired visibility product.

Retain roots as inference units, fixed failure rules/margins, sequential two-root canaries, one mixed-sign rerun, and at least six new roots for claims; bind exact endpoints, allocation, intervals, multiplicity, missingness, and distinct safety estimands before generation.
Retain the fresh reviewer veto, non-overriding advocate, and separate exact human GPU and claim authority. Reworked architecture must first complete a new exact deliberation.
